invariants: One execution reuses a checkout only for equal repository and commit identities.
Each reused checkout verifies its origin and fetched commit.
Retained exact file bytes never exceed 64 MiB.

findings.counterexample: Caching one file still created another checkout for a second file at the same commit.
findings.repair: Key one execution-owned checkout by repository and commit, then retrieve each path from that verified checkout.

mechanical_evidence.real_acceptance: RICO registration attempt 3 reduced the repeated external retrieval path but exposed later producer-verification and loader costs.
